motion: Six frames at 130ms intervals. Frame 000: section entering from below, eyebrow + headline at partial opacity (glyphs visibly dimmed toward the page background, translated down). Frame 001-002: eyebrow and h2 resolve to full #F7F8F8 with translateY settled at matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0). Frames 003, 004 and 005 are byte-identical (213909 bytes each) — the reveal has completed; the four .sk-group rows had not yet crossed the observer threshold at that scroll depth (group 1 top sits at ~759 CSS px, under the 776px dock), so the filmstrip shows the headline reveal only. Verified separately by scrolling to the section and holding 3s: all four groups reach opacity 1, transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0). Transition property is exactly 'opacity, transform', duration 0.62s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); transition-delay across the four groups is 0s / 0.07s / 0.14s / 0.21s = 70ms stagger. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, .sk-group is opacity 1, no transform, transition-duration 1e-05s. Motion is fully compliant with SPEC 1.3.
biggestGap: Delete the 01–04 ordinal rail on .sk-idx and pull the .sk-name headings back to the 20px page gutter, because that rail measures 3.47:1 contrast (#62676F on #08090A — under the 4.5:1 floor), repeats the caption tier at exactly the eyebrow's 13px, and pushes every group heading to x=60 against the headline's x=20, giving the section two competing left edges.
